'''Karena''' (Japanese: '''キクヨ''' ''Kikuyo'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW012|Here Comes the Trubbish Squad!]]''.

Karena, alongside her granddaughter [[Daniela]], is the owner of a [[Pokémon Day Care|Day Care]] close to [[Nacrene City]]. When {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}} and {{an|Cilan}} arrived at the Day Care, they found a group of schoolchildren rebelling against their teacher for not allowing them to keep {{p|Trubbish}}. Karena helped the children to keep Trubbish by revealing that Trubbish loses its bad odor once it befriends a person. 

In the end, she gave Ash a [[Pokémon Egg]] as a reward for all his efforts in helping the children.
